name: Spouse DOB Validation — Future Date Entered
goal: User enters a spouse DOB that is a future date; bot enforces DOB validation and re-prompts.
constraints: Spouse DOB entered is a future date (e.g., '31 Dec 2050').

result.message: You are eligible to book an appointment.

User enters future date as spouse DOB.
